suggested_fix: Write real execution tips (seat height, back against pad, press to near-lockout, controlled eccentric) and safety tips (do not lock elbows, keep lumbar supported).

problem: executionTips and safetyTips are entirely placeholder strings: ["//","//","//"]. The Italian localisation is empty in practice.
suggested_fix: Translate the newly written English tips.

problem: safetyTips array contains the literal i18n key "safety_tips_en" as its third element, leaking a template placeholder into user-facing text.
suggested_fix: Replace the "safety_tips_en" element with a real safety tip, or drop it (the Italian array has only the 4 genuine tips, which is why EN=5 and IT=4).

problem: translations contain a leaked i18n placeholder token (safety_tips_/execution_tips_ pattern) instead of real prose.
suggested_fix: Regenerate the affected tip entry with real coaching text.

problem: First executionTip is the placeholder "//", and the second contains the typo "Sdraiaiti" (should be "Sdraiati"). Italian has 5 tips vs 4 in English.

problem: Placeholder "//" entries present in the tips arrays. Same defect affects 16 exercises catalogue-wide: muscle_up_on_vertical_bar, shoulder_grip_pull_up, tempo_air_squat, dumbbell_incline_bench_press, dumbbell_lying_one_arm_press, dumbbell_lying_one_arm_supinated_triceps_extension, dumbbell_lying_supination, dumbbell_one_arm_shoulder_press, band_one_arm_twisting_chest_press, groin_crunch, kettlebell_two_arm_military_press, lever_seated_hip_abduction, medicine_ball_supine_chest_throw, weighted_crunch, dumbbell_rotation_reverse_fly, lever_shoulder_press_v_3.
suggested_fix: Run a catalogue-wide sweep for tip elements equal to "//" and regenerate or remove them; add a NOT-"//" check to the ingest pipeline.

problem: safetyTips says "Utilizzare un supporto o un assistente per la sicurezza" (EN: "Use a support or an assistant for safety") but spotter_policy = none. The text contradicts the stored classification.
suggested_fix: Set spotter_policy = recommended_high_effort (a HSPU genuinely warrants a spotter), or remove the assistant clause from both locales.

problem: technical_demand = low for a full handstand push-up, while the tips describe balancing inverted and controlling a cervical-spine-loaded eccentric.
suggested_fix: Set technical_demand = high; the tips already imply it.

problem: The stored name (and translations.en.name / translations.it.name) is "Alternating Alternating Dumbbell Floor Press" - the word is duplicated, a de-duplication artefact in the name builder.
suggested_fix: Rename to "Alternating Dumbbell Floor Press" in name and both locale name fields.

problem: Description explicitly says "alternating the movement between both arms" yet unilateral = false and side_mode = optional.
suggested_fix: Set unilateral = true and side_mode = separate so logging matches the described execution.

problem: Description opens with "Unilateral knee flexion exercise on a stability ball" and the exercise carries the 'unilateral' tag, but unilateral = false; the tips describe a pure bodyweight ball curl while tracking is weight_reps / total_load / equipment_instance.
suggested_fix: Set unilateral = true, bodyweight = true, tracking_type = bodyweight_reps, load_input_mode = none, comparison_scope = bodyweight_aware.

problem: Description correctly describes a barbell overhead press from the front rack, but the only muscle linked is rectus_abdominis (primary). No deltoid or triceps at all - the tips and the classification cannot both be right.
suggested_fix: Restore the deltoid_anterior / deltoid_lateral / triceps_brachii_long primaries and demote rectus_abdominis to stabilizer.

problem: Description says "Torso extension on a GHD machine using an external load" but the only linked muscle is rectus_abdominis (primary) - the antagonist of the described movement.
suggested_fix: Link erector_spinae / multifidus / gluteus_maximus / hamstrings as in the sibling 'hyperextension' record and drop rectus_abdominis as primary.

problem: Description is a pike push-up (a vertical press) but only deltoid_anterior is linked; triceps and serratus, which the movement clearly loads, are absent.
suggested_fix: Add triceps_brachii_long (primary) and serratus_anterior / pectoralis_major_clavicular (secondary).

problem: Description says "Rear delt flyes ... with the torso leaned forward" yet the primary muscle is deltoid_ANTERIOR; deltoid_posterior is not linked at all.
suggested_fix: Replace deltoid_anterior with deltoid_posterior as primary (rhomboids / trapezius_middle stay as they are).

problem: Description says "focusing on the posterior deltoid" but deltoid_anterior is stored as primary and deltoid_posterior is missing.
suggested_fix: Swap deltoid_anterior for deltoid_posterior as primary; also reclassify joint_class to multi_joint since it is a row with elbow flexion.

problem: Description says "maintaining straight arms", which excludes elbow flexion, yet biceps_brachii_long is stored as a PRIMARY mover and triceps_brachii_long as secondary.
suggested_fix: Drop biceps_brachii_long as primary (stabilizer at most); leave deltoid_anterior as the sole primary.

problem: Description is "One-arm dumbbell triceps extension" but deltoid_anterior is stored as primary alongside triceps_brachii_long, and the two lateral/medial triceps heads are only secondary.
suggested_fix: Demote deltoid_anterior to stabilizer and promote triceps_brachii_lateral / _medial to primary.

problem: Description is a vertical dumbbell press (shoulder + elbow), but the record inherited archetype=lateral_raise_db: joint_class = single_joint and the muscle/tension profile of a lateral raise (deltoid_anterior none/moderate/high, triceps primary with the same raise curve).
suggested_fix: Set joint_class = multi_joint and re-derive muscles/tension from an overhead-press archetype.

problem: Description says "performed on a lever machine" and resistance_source = cam_machine, but the only linked equipment is 'dumbbell'. Also the primary is deltoid_anterior with trapezius_middle, while deltoid_LATERAL - the point of the exercise - is absent.
suggested_fix: Link a lateral raise / lever machine equipment row instead of dumbbell, and set deltoid_lateral as primary.

problem: Description is "ankle plantar flexion" on a cable, but biceps_femoris_long is stored as a PRIMARY mover and gluteus_maximus as secondary - hamstring/glute involvement copied in from a hip-hinge archetype.
suggested_fix: Remove biceps_femoris_long and gluteus_maximus; keep gastrocnemius medial/lateral primary and soleus secondary.

problem: Name says "Lying" while the description says "performed sitting on a sled machine"; additionally biceps_femoris_long is primary and gluteus_maximus secondary on a pure calf isolation.
suggested_fix: Align name and description (lying/supine leg-press calf press) and strip the hamstring/glute links.

problem: Description says the movement emphasises "the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the soleus", but soleus is stored as SECONDARY and gastrocnemius_medial as PRIMARY with tension low/low/low - inverted for a bent-knee (seated) calf raise where the gastrocnemius is slack.
suggested_fix: Make soleus the primary and the gastrocnemius heads secondary.

problem: Text correctly describes a dumbbell held between the feet on a flat bench, but resistance_source = cam_machine (inherited from archetype=leg_curl_lying) - there is no machine in this exercise.
suggested_fix: Set resistance_source = gravity.

problem: Description says "the barbell or dumbbells are dragged vertically" while only 'dumbbell' equipment is linked and load_input_mode = per_implement, which is wrong if a barbell is used.
suggested_fix: Either split into barbell and dumbbell variants, or narrow the description to dumbbells only.

problem: Execution text references a resistance band for assistance, but the only linked equipment is 'pull_up_bar' - the band is missing from exercise_equipment.
suggested_fix: Add a resistance_band_loop equipment row (required = true).

problem: Text and biomechanics describe a bodyweight-leverage rollout (resistance_source = bodyweight_leverage, tracking_type = bodyweight_reps) yet bodyweight = false; also deltoid_anterior is stored as a primary mover on an anti-extension core drill.
suggested_fix: Set bodyweight = true and demote deltoid_anterior to stabilizer.

problem: Description says "performed with one leg" and unilateral = true, but side_mode = none, so per-side loads cannot be logged.
suggested_fix: Set side_mode = separate.

problem: gluteus_maximus is linked twice on the same exercise, once as secondary and once as primary - a duplicated row that will double-count the muscle in any aggregation.
suggested_fix: Delete the duplicate exercise_muscle row and keep a single gluteus_maximus entry.

problem: Description is a lunge combined with a curl, but the record inherited archetype=curl_standing: vastus_lateralis carries the curl tension curve low/high/low and no glute is linked, while joint_class/tension were never re-derived for the lower-body half.
suggested_fix: Re-derive the lower-body muscles from a lunge archetype (vastus_lateralis high/moderate/low, add gluteus_maximus).

problem: Description is explicitly an isometric hold ("Holding the maximal contraction") but tracking_type = weight_reps, so users log repetitions rather than time. Same pattern on offset_axle_deadlift_hold.
suggested_fix: Set tracking_type = weight_time.

problem: Isometric hold tracked as bodyweight_reps rather than time; same issue on push_up_ring_support_hold.
suggested_fix: Set tracking_type = time for pure bodyweight holds.

problem: Description is a seated calf press, but method_note records archetype=ohp_seated (seated overhead press) - the record inherited its biomechanics from an unrelated upper-body archetype, and biceps_femoris_long is linked as a secondary mover.
suggested_fix: Re-derive from a calf_raise_seated archetype and drop biceps_femoris_long.

problem: Description is a bodyweight ring fly with feet on the ground (bodyweight = true, tracking_type = bodyweight_reps) yet resistance_source = gravity rather than bodyweight_leverage; deltoid_anterior is also stored as co-primary with the pec.
suggested_fix: Set resistance_source = bodyweight_leverage and demote deltoid_anterior to secondary.

problem: Description is a straight-arm lateral raise held in a T position, yet triceps_brachii_long is stored as a PRIMARY mover and deltoid_lateral is absent (deltoid_anterior is primary instead).
suggested_fix: Set deltoid_lateral as primary and demote triceps_brachii_long to stabilizer.

problem: Description correctly describes a knee-dominant quad exercise, but gastrocnemius_medial is stored as a PRIMARY mover alongside the quadriceps.
suggested_fix: Demote gastrocnemius_medial to stabilizer.

problem: Description is circular rotation of the wrists only, yet joint_class = multi_joint and method_note records archetype=stretch while exercise_kind = mobility.
suggested_fix: Set joint_class = single_joint.

problem: The name contains both "Extension" and "Row" while the description and every tip describe a prone incline cable row - the name is a concatenation artefact.
suggested_fix: Rename to "Cable Rope Incline Bench Row".

problem: Execution text refers to a barbell while the only linked equipment is 'smith_machine'; the two are not interchangeable for the described setup.
suggested_fix: Reword the text to say "the Smith machine bar".

problem: Text refers to the cable/pulley but resistance_source is derived from lat_pulldown_machine only; minor wording inconsistency, no equipment row for the cable stack.
suggested_fix: No data change needed; optionally align the wording with the linked equipment.
